items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Bunk Johnson was supposed to have been on trumpet. This is 1945. INTERVIEWEE: No, I wasn't in that band.

ctx.x: Yeah. A trumpet player. He used to talk about him all the time. Otherwise, he'd... He liked Freddie Keppard's playing very much, more than anybody in New Orleans. He didn't speak too much about Bunk Johnson.
Did he talk about Buddy Bolden?
